day1.title: Day 1: The Beginning
day1.subtitle: Arrival, Fort Group Allocations, Cleaning Drive & Village Survey
day1.caption: From the campus to the community, the journey of service begins! 🚌✨ Day 1 at Jamgaon was all about setting the foundation. From setting up our "Fort" groups to our very first village survey, the energy is high and the mission is clear. 🏘️🤝

day2.title: Day 2: Spirit & Service (Ganesh Jayanti Special)
day2.subtitle: Temple Area Shramdaan, Community Bhandara & Shiv Charitra
day2.caption: Shramdaan, Spirituality, and Shiv Charitra. 🚩🙏 Started our morning with temple cleaning and ended the night with the inspiring history of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. Celebrating Ganesh Jayanti with the villagers through a community dinner was the highlight of the day! 🍛🔥

day3.title: Day 3: Solving Problems & Building Bonds
day3.subtitle: Drainage Shramdaan, Art of Living, Tug of War & Chhava Movie Night
day3.caption: Real hands, real work, real impact. 🛠️💪 Today we tackled a major drainage issue in the village, channeling stagnant water away from the school. But it wasn’t all work—the Tug of War battle was INTENSE! 🔥🎬

day4.title: Day 4: Tradition & Awareness
day4.subtitle: Road Safety Awareness, Traditional Dindi Sohala, Lazim & Pravachan
day4.caption: Culture, devotion, and discipline. 🚩🥁 A day filled with the rhythm of the Dindi Sohala! Walking through the village with the Palkhi, performing Lazim, and feeling the 'Josh' was unforgettable. We also learned crucial lessons on road safety and the value of hard work. 🛑🚶‍♂️

day5.title: Day 5: Resilience & Heights
day5.subtitle: Disali School Ground Leveling, Treasure Hunt & Everest Lecture
day5.caption: Testing our limits and aiming for the summit! ⛰️🧱 We pushed through hard labor leveling the ground at Disali School and wrapped up the day listening to the incredible journey of an Everester. From the ground to the peak, inspiration was everywhere. 🐍⚒️
highlights: 🏔️ "Journey to Sagarmatha" with Shri Hari Tapkir Sir

day6.title: Day 6: Republic Day & The Legend
day6.subtitle: Republic Day Flag Hoisting, Sneh Milan, Mega Health Camp & Padma Shri Popatrao Pawar
day6.caption: 🇮🇳 A Republic Day etched in history! 🇮🇳 We celebrated the nation with the tricolor flying high and had the absolute honor of hosting Padmashree Popatrao Pawar Sir. His words on sustainable development fueled our fire. Plus, a massive shoutout to our Alumni for the Sneh Milan! ❤️🏥
highlights: 🇮🇳 Republic Day Flag Hoisting & Street Play

day7.title: Day 7: The Grand Finale
day7.subtitle: Menstrual Hygiene, Military Discipline, Meditation & Valedictory Powada
day7.caption: Seven days of memories, a lifetime of lessons. ❤️🏕️ From military discipline to women’s empowerment, our final day was packed with learning. As the campfire burned one last time, we celebrated our bond, our service, and the spirit of NSS. Until next time, Jamgaon! 👋🔥
highlights: 🎖️ Military Discipline Session with Wing Cmdr. Gunchandran Sir
